limitations: BioEmu2 samples a model distribution; the ensemble is not a measured thermodynamic population and its populations are uncalibrated.
Sample order is generation order, not physical time or a kinetic trajectory.
Physicality checking reports per-frame results in physicality.json; every generated frame is retained and no frame is removed because of the report.
BioEmu2 queries the public ColabFold MMseqs2 service (api.colabfold.com) for the sequence alignment on every run.
The released checkpoint is a preview; upstream tested it with an 80 GB A100 as the smallest device.
